reason: First D01/D02 outputs reversed wing sweep in TOP; correct projection and hinge orientation without changing the two design directions.

variants.prompt:
Use case: precise targeted image edit.
Correct ONLY the WINGS and their hinge presentation in IMAGE 1. Preserve the selected pirate DRAUGR design: body silhouette, armour, shoulders, fixed rear circular core, single rear engine, colours, every cockpit feature, cargo hatch, title, three-view layout and illustration style. Do not redesign or simplify the hull. The original generated TOP view has the wings sweeping BACKWARDS toward the engine; this is a technical error. Reverse their sweep so tips reach FORWARD toward the cockpit, matching actual FLIGHT geometry in images 2 and 3. Image 4 is immutable cabin reference, preserve that cabin. This is NOT the folded pose.

CRITICAL PLAN-VIEW CORRECTION:
In the lower-right TOP / FLIGHT view the NOSE points UP. The INNER wing roots stay at their existing side sockets. The entire LEFT wing must go OUTWARD-LEFT and UPWARD on the PAGE from its root toward its tip. The entire RIGHT wing must go OUTWARD-RIGHT and UPWARD on the PAGE from its root toward its tip. OUTER TIPS must be significantly HIGHER ON THE PAGE than the roots, closer to the cockpit, not lower toward the rear engine. Move the entire wing planform, not just a tiny hooked tip. The pair should look like a broad V opening toward the nose. Do not rotate the ship or flip the full image. Preserve appropriate left-right symmetry, original span, solid depth, angular detail and clear inner/outer articulation break. Wings remain below the hull shoulder plane, with room to roll upward when stowing.

PROJECT THAT SAME corrected forward-swept wing geometry into the large LEFT perspective and the upper-right SIDE view. SIDE nose is RIGHT; the wing descends and extends to the RIGHT / toward the nose from its root, not down-left toward the engine. In the perspective the near wing reaches out and FORWARD toward the low cockpit, with flight DOWNWARD droop. Do not change roots to a different place between views.
True mechanism: closed telescoping inner carrier at body; separate outer wing on a fore-aft-axis hinge near elbow. Hinge axle runs PARALLEL to the fuselage nose-to-tail axis, allowing outer wing tips to roll UP ~63 degrees. A hinge barrel side is long, not a huge circular disk facing port/starboard. Keep robust mechanical housings but replace any incorrectly side-facing hinge disk with a fore-aft barrel inside a thick closed fork bearing and retain articulation clearance. Do not add exposed pipes/rods or skeletal frames. All views flight, outer wings angle down/out, not up.
The rectangular top cargo lid remains closed and free to slide BACK toward the engine under its shoulder pocket; add only one small unobtrusive arrow beside the lid in TOP pointing toward the rear / DOWN the page labelled BAYDOOR. Do not attach any part to that lid or across its travel.
Crisp sharp forms, meaningful medium-scale details, no rivets, no extra wings, no new cockpit glass, no scenery. Output exactly one revised three-view concept sheet with existing D01 or D02 title unchanged. Do not print any explanatory text.
D01 specific: preserve the split tall sharp aft crown and broad angular chisel wings. In the TOP view existing root centers are about y=660 of a 1024-high page; corrected outer leading tips should be about y=500-540, clearly ABOVE the roots, instead of the incorrect current y~810. Keep these as broad stepped CHISEL wings, not thin pointed needles. Preserve the tall crown entirely.
